lead_raw_text:
The structure of DyCuAg crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms—4 Dy, 4 Cu, and 4 Ag—distributed across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Ag and Cu center has 12 geometric neighbors (6 Dy, 3 Ag, 3 Cu), while each Dy center has 16 neighbors (4 Ag, 6 Cu, 6 Dy), all described as close-packed-like local arrangements with neighbor distances of 2.8987 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ag and Cu 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Ag and Dy 16-vertex polyhedra.
